planName: Track model string and reasoning effort in the Workcell Wiki layer
summary: Introduce model string and reasoning effort tracking across the Workcell Wiki layer. Extend wiki.py record to accept optional --model and --effort flags and store them in raw/<id>/manifest.json. Extend wiki.py pattern to inspect cited manifests and format citations as `<raw-id>` [<model>·<effort>] (or [<model>] if effort is null). Update wiki.py check to validate single-line string formatting while preserving 100% backward compatibility for legacy manifests and pattern lines. Document model and effort fields in agents/handoff.md, skills/build/SKILL.md, and skills/review-fix-loop/SKILL.md, and synchronize replicas across all 4 harnesses using scripts/sync-skills.py.

architecture.changeSummary: Enhance the Workcell Wiki layer to capture model provenance and reasoning effort alongside recorded evidence bundles and pattern citations. The wiki store records raw trace manifests with optional model and effort properties, automatically includes model and effort tags in pattern page evidence lines, and validates integrity via wiki.py check. The agent handoff contract (agents/handoff.md) and consumer skills (skills/build and skills/review-fix-loop) are updated to propagate model and effort metadata, and harness replicas are synchronized via scripts/sync-skills.py.

components.name: WikiStoreCLI
components.purpose: Implements record, pattern, and check CLI commands with model and effort tracking and validation in skills/wiki/scripts/wiki.py.

components.name: WikiLayoutContract
components.purpose: Defines the specification and schema for manifest.json and pattern page citation formats in skills/wiki/references/wiki-layout.md.

components.name: AgentHandoffContract
components.purpose: Specifies optional model and effort fields in dispatch briefs and anvil.agent-handoff/v1 return records in agents/handoff.md.

components.name: OrchestratorSkills
components.purpose: Documents passing model and effort parameters during wave acceptance in skills/build/SKILL.md and review-fix-loop exit consolidation in skills/review-fix-loop/SKILL.md.

components.name: HarnessReplicas
components.purpose: Maintains synchronized copies of the shared wiki skill across claude, codex, agy, and grok harnesses.

issues.title: Document model string and reasoning effort in agent handoff contract
issues.body: Update agents/handoff.md to formally specify optional model and effort fields across both the orchestrator dispatch brief and the anvil.agent-handoff/v1 return record. Include clear semantics: model names the model string (e.g. claude-sonnet-5, gemini-3.7-flash), and effort indicates the reasoning effort level (e.g. low, medium, high). Update both JSON schema examples to demonstrate model and effort tracking.

acceptanceTests.name: handoff_record_documents_model_and_effort

acceptanceTests.name: handoff_examples_include_model_and_effort

issues.title: Add model and effort tracking to wiki store CLI and verification gates
issues.body: Enhance skills/wiki/scripts/wiki.py and skills/wiki/references/wiki-layout.md to track model string and reasoning effort. In wiki.py record, add optional --model and --effort flags, sanitize them with one_line(), and store them in raw/<id>/manifest.json. In wiki.py pattern, automatically inspect cited raw manifests and format citations as `<raw-id>` [<model>·<effort>] (or `<raw-id>` [<model>] if effort is null, or legacy `<raw-id>` if model is omitted). Update EVIDENCE_LINE regex and check_patterns to validate both legacy and model-tagged lines. In wiki.py check, validate that if model and effort are present in manifests or pattern lines, they are sanitized single-line strings. Maintain 100% backward compatibility for legacy manifests and pattern lines. Add comprehensive unit and integration tests to skills/wiki/tests/test_wiki.py.

acceptanceTests.name: record_stores_sanitized_model_and_effort
acceptanceTests.oracle: wiki.py record --model <str> --effort <str> persists sanitized strings for model and effort in manifest.json.

acceptanceTests.name: record_supports_optional_and_null_model_effort
acceptanceTests.oracle: wiki.py record without --model and --effort succeeds and produces a valid manifest with null or omitted model and effort.

acceptanceTests.name: pattern_formats_model_and_effort_attribution
acceptanceTests.oracle: wiki.py pattern citing a bundle with model and effort formats the citation as `<raw-id>` [<model>·<effort>].

acceptanceTests.name: pattern_formats_model_only_attribution
acceptanceTests.oracle: wiki.py pattern citing a bundle with model and null effort formats the citation as `<raw-id>` [<model>].

acceptanceTests.name: pattern_formats_legacy_unattributed_citation
acceptanceTests.oracle: wiki.py pattern citing a bundle without model produces an unbracketed legacy `<raw-id>` citation.

acceptanceTests.name: check_validates_sanitized_model_and_effort
acceptanceTests.oracle: wiki.py check exits 0 when manifests and pattern lines contain sanitized single-line model and effort strings.

acceptanceTests.name: check_preserves_legacy_backward_compatibility
acceptanceTests.oracle: wiki.py check exits 0 on namespaces containing legacy manifests without model/effort and pattern lines without model tags.

acceptanceTests.name: check_rejects_unsanitized_model_or_effort
acceptanceTests.oracle: wiki.py check exits non-zero and reports errors when manifest or pattern model/effort contains newlines or invalid characters.

acceptanceTests.name: layout_contract_specifies_model_and_effort
acceptanceTests.oracle: skills/wiki/references/wiki-layout.md specifies the manifest schema fields and the bracketed evidence line citation format.

issues.title: Synchronize wiki layer changes across all harness skill replicas
issues.body: Run python3 scripts/sync-skills.py to propagate the updated wiki CLI, layout contracts, and tests to all four harness skill directories (harnesses/claude/skills/wiki, harnesses/codex/skills/wiki, harnesses/agy/skills/wiki, and harnesses/grok/skills/wiki). Verify that python3 scripts/sync-skills.py --check reports zero drift across all 16 skills and 4 harnesses, and verify that harness-level tests execute cleanly.

acceptanceTests.oracle: python3 scripts/sync-skills.py --check exits 0 with message confirming all skills in sync across 4 harnesses.

risks.title: Existing raw manifests lacking model and effort fields cause wiki.py check or pattern parsing errors
risks.mitigation: Enforce backward-compatibility tests in test_wiki.py asserting that manifests without model/effort keys pass wiki.py check and produce valid unbracketed pattern citations.

risks.title: Modifying skills/build/SKILL.md breaks wave loop contract assertions in test_build.py or test_skill_contracts.py
risks.mitigation: Keep the verbatim required phrases intact (wiki.py record, --kind build-wave, wiki.py status --repo .) and run WikiBuildTraceTests as a verification gate.

risks.title: Harness skill copies fall out of sync with canonical skills/wiki
risks.mitigation: Run python3 scripts/sync-skills.py --check in Wave 3 to mechanically guarantee zero file drift across all 4 harnesses.
